lexical.summary: 为什么 document_links 的修复没有解决「问如何烤面包却得到面包做法」？
lexical.resolution: 结论：这是两个不同的问题，而我把验收标准选错了。修复 A（service v0.1.6，commit 8212ffd）只消除了 graph 数组里全局 top-N 文档对的注入，它自身的主张成立且已实测（无关查询 DocumentLink=0，TSOD/crashdump 仍为 3）。但用户可见症状由另一条路径造成：扩展聊天路径 extension.ts:64 的提示词写的是「Answer the user directly ... Use the retrieved context only when relevant」，即无相关证据时仍要求直接回答；同时 extension.ts:50-58 的「found no relevant active knowledge」分支只在服务返回 0 条时才触发，而服务端没有相关性下限（vector_store.py:71-72 仅判断 score > 0），实测该查询返回 6 条不相关条目，length 非 0，该分支实为死代码。A 与症状之间没有因果关系：改或不改，面包答案都会出现。方法论错误：我用一个容易测量的代理指标（DocumentLink 计数）当作验收标准，而不是用户可见结果（对无证据的问题是否拒答或明确分区）；更严重的是同一个会话里我已经拿到了症状证据（面包答案，含 6 条不相关 RETRIEVED ITEMS），却把它解释成「符合 L0 的免责声明」放过，接着继续宣布修复成功。今后此类改动的验收标准必须是端到端黑盒：对一个知识库里明显没有的主题提问，检查回答是否声称有证据、是否拒答或是否明确分区，而不是检查 JSON 字段计数。

The Platform Environmental Control Interface (PECI) is the single wire interface that we use for
out of band manageability (supports thermal monitoring, CSR R/W, etc.) of the processors.
Each processor is a PECI secondary device and one PECI host exists in the system, typically a
management processor (aka BMC). We will be PECI 4.1 compliant on the interface – PECI 4.1
is electrically the same as PECI 3.1 (same as prior platforms).
The highest PECI rate capable is 2Mbps (2MHz) with a 3rd party host. The ability to meet any
ingredient rate is ultimately determined by the platform topology. PECI 3.1 VTT range is 0.9V to
1.26V; VTT on Birch Stream is sourced by VNN. VNN is nominally 1.0V so we are fully
compliant with the VCCPECI requirements.
PECI communication is only allowed/responded to after CPU_RESET_N is de-asserted. Note
MSR/TPMI PECI read failures (0x81/0x82/0x83 CC) resulting in CPU count going to 0 and preceding host soft reset.
